summary: A factual capability overview: configurable tabular rules, explicit matching metadata and public APIs for filtering and accumulation. No benchmark, hot-reload or universal backend-parity claim is established by this profile.

concepts.name: Public engine and result surface
concepts.description: The package exports filter and accumulator engines, results, lattice types and helpers; source exports establish availability, not operational guarantees.

concepts.name: Rules described by metadata
concepts.description: Dimension definitions and YAML serialization are concrete evidence for inspectable configuration rather than rule-specific branching.

concepts.name: Explicit matching vocabulary
concepts.description: Named matching strategies, policies and typed sentinel conventions make rule behavior describable; edge conditions remain part of the technical contract.

documentation_plan: Use small source-backed examples to communicate capabilities.
Keep performance, automated reload/deployment and unsupported backend assertions out of the overview.
